description: This file contains testing utilities and a Tester class for testing Kubernetes API server registry implementations, including methods for creating, updating, deleting, listing, and watching objects within the registry.

classes.name: Tester
classes.description: A utility class for testing Kubernetes registry implementations, providing methods for common test operations such as create, update, delete, get, list, and watch.

methods.name: New
methods.description: Constructor for creating a new Tester instance with a given testing.T and storage.

methods.name: TestNamespace
methods.description: Returns the namespace used in tests.

methods.name: ClusterScope
methods.description: Sets the tester to cluster scope.

methods.name: SetUserInfo
methods.description: Sets user information for the tester.

methods.name: Namer
methods.description: Sets a custom namer function for the tester.

methods.name: AllowCreateOnUpdate
methods.description: Allows create on update in tests.

methods.name: GeneratesName
methods.description: Configures the tester to generate names.

methods.name: ReturnDeletedObject
methods.description: Configures the tester to return deleted objects.

methods.name: SetRequestInfo
methods.description: Sets request info for the tester.

methods.name: TestCreate
methods.description: Tests creation of objects.

methods.name: TestUpdate
methods.description: Tests updating objects.

methods.name: TestDelete
methods.description: Tests deleting objects.

methods.name: TestDeleteGraceful
methods.description: Tests graceful deletion of objects.

methods.name: TestGet
methods.description: Tests retrieving objects.

methods.name: TestList
methods.description: Tests listing objects.

methods.name: TestWatch
methods.description: Tests watching objects.

methods.name: getObject
methods.description: Helper to retrieve an object from storage.

methods.name: createObject
methods.description: Helper to create an object in storage.

methods.name: setObjectsForList
methods.description: Prepares a list of objects for listing tests.

methods.name: emitObject
methods.description: Simulates an action (create/delete) on an object.
